verdict.rationale: Cua documents running Spaces on infrastructure you pick: a Mac on your desk, a LAN or Tailscale server, or a VM in your own AWS, Google Cloud or Modal account. That gives you indirect control over where Space data lives, but there is no documented region or residency selector for Cua's hosted service. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection for hosted Spaces, documentation of where the account-wide Cua Volume and audit log are stored, and any data-residency guarantees or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Connect a Mac on your desk, a spare box in the office or a VM in your own AWS, Google Cloud or Modal account. Each one runs Spaces
Any machine that runs cua-spacesd, such as a spare Mac, a server on your LAN or Tailscale... connects directly by address and env token.
Your Spaces and their data stay unless you ask for them to go.
